name: Los Hinojosos (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and red, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Los Hinojosos (a cross of Saint James and a castle on white and red).
history: Municipal flag of Los Hinojosos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Los Hinojosos arms — cross of Saint James and castle
